Concrete original SOW canonical and alias requests retain requested support and reach appropriate review, without declaring qualification.
Boilerplate-only, guidance-only, quoted historical work, explicit negation and name-only collisions cannot establish requested support or a recommendation.

Guidance incorporated as an actual deliverable and not-only wording remain positive controls.
Thin/title-only/missing material context remains unresolved; no automatic functional mismatch or blanket escalation.

Under bounded overflow, retain honest unresolved evidence coverage.
Original absolute offsets and context-relative offsets remain distinguishable and reconstructable; field/record hash and source identity survive.
Actual API raw.description and CSV raw.description_snippet reach the model context stub with no network/model call; a URL-only description is not full text.
Attachment text retains discovery-only bundle/file provenance, truncation and missing/unreadable distinctions.
Wrong source identity, field, quote, original offset, hash, current taxonomy or altered role support is rejected/recomputed at the consuming boundary.
A user-supplied semantic_role or source-verified flag cannot authenticate itself.
Cross-notice context remains attributed and cannot supply own-notice requested support, deadline, route or current action.
Changed/later amendment negation cannot inherit the prior positive as current; original history remains readable.
Standalone all-inputs-omitted validation is explicitly shape/projection-only; reviewed alias taxonomy lookup is not stored-source proof.
Partial current inputs refuse. Missing both loaded and derived taxonomy refuses before native machine press.
Present taxonomy with missing/wrong source refuses; complete authentic source/support succeeds.
Any API/schema change distinguishing validation modes is isolated with legacy/operator-card controls.
